<style>
@font-face {
  font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible";
  font-weight: 400;
  src: url("fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-latin-400-normal.woff2") format("woff2");
}
@font-face {
  font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible";
  font-weight: 700;
  src: url("fonts/atkinson-hyperlegible-latin-700-normal.woff2") format("woff2");
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

:root {
  --navy:  #1f335e;
  --blue:  #003cb3;
  --orange: #ff9100;
  --muted: #f0f4fa;
  --border: #c6d2e8;
  --text:  #222832;
  --small: #555;
}

@page { size: letter; margin: 0.4in 0.5in; }

body {
  font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 9pt;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--text);
  background: #fff;
  max-width: 7.5in;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0.25in 0;
}

.handout-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.9em;
  padding-bottom: 0.45em;
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--orange);
  margin-bottom: 0.6em;
}

.handout-header img { height: 36px; width: auto; flex-shrink: 0; }

.handout-header-text h1 {
  font-size: 13pt;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--navy);
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin: 0;
}

.handout-header-text p {
  font-size: 8pt;
  color: var(--small);
  margin-top: 0.1em;
}

.handout-body {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 55% 1fr;
  gap: 1.2em;
}

.section-label {
  font-size: 7.5pt;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--navy);
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--navy);
  padding-bottom: 0.18em;
  margin-bottom: 0.45em;
}

.project-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.42em; }

.project-entry { display: flex; gap: 0.55em; align-items: flex-start; }

.project-accent {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 3px;
  background: var(--orange);
  border-radius: 2px;
  align-self: stretch;
  min-height: 2em;
}

.project-name-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.45em;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 0.08em;
}

.project-name {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-size: 9pt;
}

.project-origin {
  font-size: 7.5pt;
  color: var(--small);
}

.project-desc {
  font-size: 8.5pt;
  line-height: 1.38;
}

.project-link {
  font-size: 7.5pt;
  color: var(--blue);
  text-decoration: none;
  margin-left: 0.3em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.project-link:hover { color: var(--orange); }

.also-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.28em;
  margin-top: 0.45em;
}

.also-badge {
  background: var(--muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 0.12em 0.4em;
  font-size: 7.5pt;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.right-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6em; }

.panel { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden; }

.panel-head {
  background: var(--navy);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 7.5pt;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.28em 0.55em;
}

.panel-body { padding: 0.45em 0.55em; background: #fff; }

.panel-body p, .panel-body li { font-size: 8.5pt; line-height: 1.38; }

.stat-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.35em; margin-bottom: 0.25em; }

.stat-num { font-size: 15pt; font-weight: 700; color: var(--orange); line-height: 1; }

.stat-label { font-size: 8pt; color: var(--text); line-height: 1.3; }

.stat-divider { border: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); margin: 0.3em 0; }

.campus-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.22em; margin-top: 0.22em; }

.campus-chip {
  background: var(--orange);
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 0.1em 0.38em;
  font-size: 7pt;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.area-row { display: flex; gap: 0.3em; margin-bottom: 0.18em; }
.area-icon { color: var(--orange); flex-shrink: 0; }
.area-text { font-size: 8.5pt; }
.area-text strong { color: var(--navy); }

.resource-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.38em; margin-bottom: 0.18em; font-size: 8.5pt; }

.resource-file {
  font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 7.5pt;
  background: var(--muted);
  color: var(--navy);
  border-radius: 2px;
  padding: 0.08em 0.28em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.learn-link { display: block; font-size: 8.5pt; font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue); text-decoration: none; margin-bottom: 0.18em; }
.learn-link:hover { color: var(--orange); }

.handout-footer {
  margin-top: 0.55em;
  padding-top: 0.35em;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 7pt;
  color: var(--small);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

@media print {
  body { max-width: 100%; padding: 0; }
  a { color: var(--blue) !important; }
  .learn-link { color: var(--blue) !important; }
}
</style>

<div class="handout-header">
  <img src="images/uc-ospo-network-logo.svg" alt="UC OSPO Network">
  <div class="handout-header-text">
    <h1>UC Open Source as Institutional Infrastructure</h1>
    <p>Tim Dennis &middot; Data Science Center, UCLA Library &middot; IASSIST 2026 &middot; Slides + resources: <strong>ucospo.net</strong></p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="handout-body">

<div class="left-col">

<div class="section-label">From Dissertation to Global Infrastructure</div>

<div class="project-list">

  <div class="project-entry">
    <div class="project-accent"></div>
    <div class="project-body">
      <div class="project-name-row">
        <span class="project-name">BSD Unix</span>
        <span class="project-origin">UC Berkeley &middot; 1970s&ndash;80s</span>
      </div>
      <div class="project-desc">The permissive licensing model that made open source possible. Derivatives (MIT, Apache) now govern billions of lines of production software worldwide. <a class="project-link" href="https://www.mckusick.com/history/index.html">history &rarr;</a></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="project-entry">
    <div class="project-accent"></div>
    <div class="project-body">
      <div class="project-name-row">
        <span class="project-name">Jupyter</span>
        <span class="project-origin">UC Berkeley &middot; 2001&ndash;2014</span>
      </div>
      <div class="project-desc">Fernando P&eacute;rez built the first IPython in an afternoon procrastinating on his physics dissertation. Now the dominant interface for interactive computing across science, AI, and data education worldwide. <a class="project-link" href="https://jupyter.org">jupyter.org &rarr;</a></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="project-entry">
    <div class="project-accent"></div>
    <div class="project-body">
      <div class="project-name-row">
        <span class="project-name">UCSC Genome Browser</span>
        <span class="project-origin">UC Santa Cruz &middot; Summer 2000</span>
      </div>
      <div class="project-desc">PhD student Jim Kent assembled the human genome on 50 borrowed PCs, icing his wrists to keep coding. He finished <strong>three days before</strong> Celera Genomics and its supercomputer. The genome stayed in the public domain. <a class="project-link" href="https://genome.ucsc.edu">genome.ucsc.edu &rarr;</a></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="project-entry">
    <div class="project-accent"></div>
    <div class="project-body">
      <div class="project-name-row">
        <span class="project-name">Ceph</span>
        <span class="project-origin">UC Santa Cruz &middot; 2004</span>
      </div>
      <div class="project-desc">Sage Weil&rsquo;s PhD dissertation on exabyte-scale distributed storage. Merged into the Linux kernel (2010); proceeds from commercialization funded <strong>CROSS at UCSC</strong>, the first UC OSPO and the seed of this network. <a class="project-link" href="https://ceph.io">ceph.io &rarr;</a></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="project-entry">
    <div class="project-accent"></div>
    <div class="project-body">
      <div class="project-name-row">
        <span class="project-name">Apache Spark</span>
        <span class="project-origin">UC Berkeley AMPLab &middot; 2009</span>
      </div>
      <div class="project-desc">Matei Zaharia built it so a classmate could beat the Netflix Prize with faster distributed ML. Donated to Apache before commercializing. Databricks now valued at <strong>$62B+</strong>. <a class="project-link" href="https://spark.apache.org">spark.apache.org &rarr;</a></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="project-entry">
    <div class="project-accent"></div>
    <div class="project-body">
      <div class="project-name-row">
        <span class="project-name">RISC-V</span>
        <span class="project-origin">UC Berkeley &middot; 2010</span>
      </div>
      <div class="project-desc">A three-month summer project to avoid paying ARM royalties. Now in <strong>10 billion devices</strong>, 350+ member organizations in 70 countries. Foundation relocated to Switzerland in 2020 to stay neutral in US-China trade tensions. <a class="project-link" href="https://riscv.org">riscv.org &rarr;</a></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="project-entry">
    <div class="project-accent"></div>
    <div class="project-body">
      <div class="project-name-row">
        <span class="project-name">Ray</span>
        <span class="project-origin">UC Berkeley RISELab &middot; 2016</span>
      </div>
      <div class="project-desc">Two PhD students tired of rewriting Python to scale. Now <strong>core OpenAI compute infrastructure</strong>. Donated to the Linux Foundation in 2025. <a class="project-link" href="https://ray.io">ray.io &rarr;</a></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="project-entry">
    <div class="project-accent"></div>
    <div class="project-body">
      <div class="project-name-row">
        <span class="project-name">tz database</span>
        <span class="project-origin">UCLA &middot; maintained by Paul Eggert since 2005</span>
      </div>
      <div class="project-desc">Every OS clock on the planet depends on this. To reconstruct pre-1883 timezone history, Eggert used almanacs compiled by 19th-century astrologers. In 2011 an IP lawsuit nearly took it offline; the community rallied and IANA took stewardship. <a class="project-link" href="https://www.iana.org/time-zones">iana.org/time-zones &rarr;</a></div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
